criteria.name: Scientific contribution and distinction from closest prior work
criteria.assessment: A useful exact future-cost, resource/work, and nonterminal-repair diagnostic instrument, not a new planner or the first interactive brick-assembly benchmark. The matched support construction makes the visual diagnostic contribution more credible, while novelty remains incremental.

criteria.name: Construct validity and input-ability relationship
criteria.assessment: The count/type-color confound is genuinely removed while original registered poses and task inputs remain fixed. The intervention changes support connectivity and exact sequence legality. This establishes bounded geometric dependence, not necessary long-horizon reasoning, universal shortcut immunity, or perceptual sufficiency.

criteria.name: Dataset depth, sampling, diversity, dependence, and held-out evaluation
criteria.assessment: 81 newly admitted sources each supply 12 seeded episodes, giving 97 active source groups. Primary visual evidence is more limited: 36 pairs, 18 interventions, 12 sources, including 24 pairs from nine held-out sources. Source-balanced scoring and 98/116 zero-yield intervention disclosure support the narrow diagnostic claim without promoting rows to independent sources.

criteria.name: Ground truth, scoring, edge cases, failure denominators, and shortcuts
criteria.assessment: Exact pair labels, one-sided/missing-answer denominators, calibration separation, and valid ties are implemented and regression-tested. Independent replay and eight complete table checks passed. The separately completed 650-table audit reports no cost/length discrepancies and all questions/pairs passing. Information ceilings are correctly restricted rather than presented as fitted held-out predictors.

criteria.name: Experiment design and uncertainty under the completion assumption
criteria.assessment: Matched static/active/structured conditions and source-level uncertainty can support interpretable outcomes, including null or negative results. Actual answerability, visual benefits, human-model gaps, and superiority remain conditional. Nine retained held-out visual source groups constrain inference; zero deterministic joint ceilings are not stochastic chance baselines.

criteria.name: Reproducibility, traceable evidence, and faithful source geometry
criteria.assessment: Whole-source identity/hierarchy gates, preserved exclusions, complete leaf-proof archives, and exact retained-instance mappings are substantive improvements. Fresh source parsing and two original-hierarchy proof replays passed in their expected scopes. Mesh/path qualification is inspected and hash-bound, not independently remeasured in full; final packaging and figures remain unassessed.

criteria.name: Narrative, readable examples, and CVPR fit
criteria.assessment: The narrow exact-label diagnostic narrative and explicit strong-control caveats are defensible for CVPR. This criterion assesses manuscript positioning only; final figures, compiled-page readability, gallery appendix overflow, and font encoding are deferred to the separate publication review.
evidence: User's explicit design-only review boundary and later typography handoff

issues.summary: The former global-count confound and inadequate construction-level replication are repaired sufficiently for the revised bounded support-geometry diagnostic.
evidence: Independent recount: 1421 episodes, 7020 probes, 97 active source groups, 142 active profiles; 81 new admitted sources each contribute exactly 12 seeded source episodes.

All 36 primary pairs match exact part-number/color inventories, registered part records/poses, start, goal, capacity, jobs, and proposed plan; exact labels differ after a legal prefix of at least two actions.
36 pairs / 18 interventions / 12 sources; 24 held-out pairs / nine held-out sources. Eight primary sources are newly admitted, six of them held out.
116 qualified primary interventions, 98 zero-yield; ten historical unmatched pairs excluded from primary scoring.
Six source-fidelity failures are absent from active questions and retain prior admission evidence, with no replacement candidates.
Fresh seed-37 controls give zero joint ceilings for six restricted representations and one for address-inclusive metadata; label-free inventory rules also have zero held-out joint credit.
35 scoring/protocol regressions and eight exact independent cost-table checks pass.
issues.why_it_matters: The intervention now isolates support-context dependence from total count and global type/color inventory, while independent source replication and exact joint scoring address the original major concern. This is not a claim of broad mechanical competence, deep visual planning, or immunity to instance-sensitive shortcuts.
closure_test: Satisfied: independently replay both exact labels and verify equality of inventories, registered original poses, state, goal, jobs, capacity, and proposed sequence for every primary pair.
Satisfied: count distinct starts/interventions/sources, preserve historical separation and zero-yield qualification records, and implement source-level weighting/uncertainty.
Satisfied: source-fidelity failures are excluded from active profiles without original-source modification or replacement.
Preserve on future banks: wrong-index, malformed-answer, missing-partner, missing-repeat, split/cohort, source-bootstrap, and representation-scope regressions.
Reopen if later claims treat this support-only cohort as evidence of long-horizon reasoning, broad physical understanding, or universal shortcut immunity without additional evidence.

residual_limitations: Primary visual evidence has nine held-out source groups, not 97 independent visual sources; only six of those nine are newly admitted sources.
Only 18 of 116 qualified matched interventions yield retained contrasts. Selection is mechanism-conditioned, not representative population sampling.
All primary geometric failures are unsupported-assembly failures; motion blockers are held fixed. Twenty-four of 36 conflicts occur at operation three, and none after operation seven.
Depth-one uniform-tie next-action accuracy is 97.35%; inverse-last solves 2260/3829 repairs; privileged 100-expansion A* solves 4075/4263 runs. Length bins are not necessary reasoning-depth evidence.
Restricted deterministic zero joint ceilings do not apply to richer local spatial features, stochastic policies, pair-position information, routing-ID memorization, or accessible evaluator files.
Source bootstrap describes sensitivity conditional on retained sources and assignments, not calibrated population coverage.
Source fidelity does not establish force balance, clutch strength, arbitrary grasp/pose competence, real rack transfer, LEGO endorsement, or retail-set completeness.
Native pixel distinction does not establish human/model answerability or robustness under every seed and preprocessing pipeline.
Public CAD may overlap model pretraining. Frozen-file consistency does not independently prove historical preregistration timing.
Final generated figures, font encoding, appendix section handling, PDF layout, and archive synchronization require the separate final publication snapshot review.

acceptance_rationale: R5 is substantively closed for the revised bounded diagnostic contribution: original-source count/type-color matching, genuine answer-changing support contexts, larger independent source replication, fail-closed whole-source fidelity, and exact source-balanced paired scoring are implemented and supported by fresh targeted checks. No new critical or major construction defect was demonstrated. The contribution is useful but incremental, visual replication remains modest, and strong privileged shallow controls limit depth claims, warranting 7 rather than a stronger score. This is not an arithmetic average, a reward for iteration count, or an assumption of favorable VLM/human results. The verdict is design-only; the complete rendered publication and final release snapshot remain independently reviewable and the protocol's final acceptance stop condition is not yet satisfied.
